title: Psalm 124
opening_line: Had not the LORD been on our side,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Had not the LORD been on our side,
text.normalized: Had not the LORD been on our side,
text.reading: Had not the LORD been on our side,

text.diplomatic: may Israèl now say;
text.normalized: May Israèl now say;
text.reading: may Israèl now say;

text.diplomatic: Had not the LORD been on our side,
text.normalized: Had not the LORD been on our side,
text.reading: Had not the LORD been on our side,

text.diplomatic: when men rose us to slay;
text.normalized: When men rose us to slay;
text.reading: when men rose us to slay;

text.diplomatic: They had us swallowed quick, when as
text.normalized: They had us swallowed quick, when as
text.reading: They had us swallowed quick, when as

text.diplomatic: their wrath ’gainst us did flame:
text.normalized: Their wrath ’gainst us did flame:
text.reading: their wrath ’gainst us did flame:

text.diplomatic: Waters had covered us, our soul
text.normalized: Waters had covered us, our soul
text.reading: Waters had covered us, our soul

text.diplomatic: had sunk beneath the stream.
text.normalized: Had sunk beneath the stream.
text.reading: had sunk beneath the stream.

text.diplomatic: Then had the waters, swelling high,
text.normalized: Then had the waters, swelling high,
text.reading: Then had the waters, swelling high,

text.diplomatic: over our soul made way.
text.normalized: Over our soul made way.
text.reading: over our soul made way.

text.diplomatic: Bless’d be the LORD, who to their teeth
text.normalized: Bless’d be the LORD, who to their teeth
text.reading: Bless’d be the LORD, who to their teeth

text.diplomatic: us gave not for a prey.
text.normalized: Us gave not for a prey.
text.reading: us gave not for a prey.

text.diplomatic: Our soul’s escapèd, as a bird
text.normalized: Our soul’s escapèd, as a bird
text.reading: Our soul’s escapèd, as a bird

text.diplomatic: out of the fowler’s snare;
text.normalized: Out of the fowler’s snare;
text.reading: out of the fowler’s snare;

text.diplomatic: The snare asunder broken is,
text.normalized: The snare asunder broken is,
text.reading: The snare asunder broken is,

text.diplomatic: and we escapèd are.
text.normalized: And we escapèd are.
text.reading: and we escapèd are.

text.diplomatic: Our sure and all-sufficient help
text.normalized: Our sure and all-sufficient help
text.reading: Our sure and all-sufficient help

text.diplomatic: is in JEHOVAH’s name;
text.normalized: Is in JEHOVAH’s name;
text.reading: is in JEHOVAH’s name;

text.diplomatic: His name who did the heav’n create,
text.normalized: His name who did the heav’n create,
text.reading: His name who did the heav’n create,

text.diplomatic: and who the earth did frame.
text.normalized: And who the earth did frame.
text.reading: and who the earth did frame.
